_comment: Get more: mods players switch on in the game, with no restart. Each one ships in the pack (pack/pack.toml, group 'qol')
and loads with the game, asleep: the settings under 'switches' are off (a leading ! marks a 'disable' setting, true while
asleep) and keys whose names start with one of 'keys' are unbound. Getting the mod sets them back to how the player had
them. 'always' holds a setting at one value whatever the mod's state. A mod only belongs here if it checks these settings
itself before it draws anything, so an asleep mod costs no frame time. 'title' and 'about' name it on the settings page,
by what it does. The order here is the order on the page.

mods.title: Keystrokes
mods.about: The keys you press and your clicks per second.

mods.title: TNT timer
mods.about: The seconds left above lit TNT, from green to red.

mods.title: Sprint status
mods.about: Shows when sprint or sneak is toggled on.

mods.title: Effect timers
mods.about: A bar under each effect shows how long it has left.

mods.title: Faster inventory
mods.about: Drag and scroll to move items in menus faster.

mods.title: Food info
mods.about: How much hunger and saturation food gives back.

mods.title: F3 screen
mods.about: A tidier, coloured F3 screen with the parts you choose.
